{{Navbar-GOGPT-tracker}}
'''Shuqaiq 2 Independent Water and Power Project''' (محطة كهرباء الشقيق المستقلة) is an operating power station of at least 1020-megawatts (MW) in Al Shuqaiq, Jizan, Saudi Arabia.
It is also known as Shuqaiq 2 IWPP.
